claim_boundary: Synthetic direct-material camera experiment only: no real labels, verified scheduled clean vial, calibrated appearance, physical carryover extent or cause, defect, sim-to-real, pure recipe generalization, latency, plant action, fill-height, wrong-volume, or stage-volume claim.
profile_boundary: Each cohort has every profile once. Profile, alpha and onset are render/label oracles only, never model inputs or reference selectors.

seed_contract.interpretation: Separate matched-nuisance counterfactual batches, not statistically independent observations.

appearance_mapping.clean_rule: programmed-mL-weighted mean of basis colours dispensed through the stage
appearance_mapping.injection_rule: at and after family onset, blend current cumulative clean stage appearance toward previous recipe final clean appearance by appearance_blend_alpha

geometry_extent_scope: Observed repeatable twin camera slots only; not mL, fill-height truth, wrong-volume truth, or physical stage-volume.

source_batch_evidence.video1: observed total 19 fills; exact recipe grouping is unknown and no grouping labels are inferred
source_batch_evidence.video2: observed total 3 fills; visual audit supports one three-fill run
source_batch_evidence.video3: observed total 6 fills; recipe grouping is unlabeled
source_batch_evidence.video4: observed total 6 fills; visual audit supports two three-fill runs
source_batch_evidence.design_basis: three-vial choice is grounded in labeled video5 and organizer guidance, not invented video1 labels

render_controls.process_attempt_policy_reference: top-level exact local Isaac 6.2 watchdog contract

measurement_contract.statistic: per-channel median CIE Lab over fixed nonempty liquid mask
measurement_contract.mask_rule: all target/candidate same-stage masks must have identical shape and SHA-256; any mismatch invalidates that reference case
measurement_contract.serialization: finite raw JSON numbers plus fixed six-decimal strings

reference_contract.cohort_separation: reference_only batches never scored; scored_target batches never external references
reference_contract.candidate_rule: later vials in target batch plus every same-stage vial from selected separate reference-only batches of exact same current recipe
reference_contract.terminal_sanity_comparison: optional reported comparison only; terminal position has no selection privilege and is never clean truth
reference_contract.one_reference_batch_rule: evaluate all four reference batches as four named alternatives; no winner or oracle-shaped choice
reference_contract.mode_assumption: The unique largest tight cluster across batches represents the majority/reference appearance mode.
reference_contract.mode_falsifier: Reference-bank contamination forming a competing or wrong majority, or ambiguous equal-size tight modes, invalidates/undermines the reference and must be reported.
reference_contract.subset_rule: enumerate all candidate subsets; accept unique largest with pairwise dE76 diameter <=2.0
reference_contract.representative_visual: selected peer closest to center; lexicographic peer_id tie break
reference_contract.vial_disposition: discard if any valid primary stage is outlier; keep only when all three primary stages are valid and inlier; otherwise insufficient_evidence
reference_contract.threshold_scope: 2.0 and 1.0 are synthetic experiment thresholds frozen before test, not real defect thresholds

cosmos_plan.model_role: Explain supplied quantitative evidence; never detect colour, choose or alter disposition, infer physical cause, or advise process/equipment changes.
cosmos_plan.contradiction_policy: Any contradiction of deterministic disposition fails content scoring; discard is synthetic vial disposition only, never plant control.
cosmos_plan.smoke_failure_policy: Record both scored image conditions as failed or skipped without reducing the frozen denominator.
